description: This file contains a mock implementation of the ILocalGrainDirectory interface used for unit testing Orleans grain directory functionalities. It provides methods to simulate registration and unregistration of grains, with some methods not implemented, serving as a test double.

classes.name: MockLocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: A mock implementation of ILocalGrainDirectory for unit testing Orleans grain directory operations.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counters and received unregistration list.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous unregistration of a single grain address.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous unregistration of multiple grain addresses.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the directory, not implemented in this mock.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the directory asynchronously, not implemented in this mock.
